subject: Pipeline gap playbook & forecast lock for Q2 coverage
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acme-hardware.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme-hardware.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline gap playbook & forecast lock for Q2 coverage

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Finance ran the numbers and we want to align on a short playbook to close the Q2 coverage gap and lock a commit for planning. Quick asks below so we can finalize by next Friday: 

- Can you confirm the top 8 deals you expect to close by EOW May 6 with an estimate of probability and expected close date? (attach a short 1-line note per deal)
- Please upload the latest pipeline snapshot and any signed MSA/SOW drafts to the shared drive link I sent last week.
- If there are any procurement or legal blockers, flag them now so we can triage with our renewals/legal team.

I've attached a blank commit sheet to fill out (ACME_Q2_commit_sheet.xlsx) — use the "Commit" column for deals you want Finance to treat as locked for Q2 planning. Finance needs a final commit list by 5pm PT on May 6 to include in the close-of-month forecast.

Why this matters: based on current velocity your rolling pipeline is ~1.6x quota but the weighted coverage to target today only hits ~0.8x. That creates a shortfall of roughly $1.2M that we should address with targeted pull-forward plays and an exec intro for one deal.

I'll follow up with a short playbook email (internally) after I see the snapshot. Appreciate a quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Director, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: ACME_Q2_commit_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acme-hardware.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme-hardware.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline gap playbook & forecast lock for Q2 coverage

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick update: I've attached a CSV snapshot and a short note on the top 8 deals (ACME_pipeline_snapshot.csv). High level:

- Weighted pipeline today: $4.8M
- Quarterly quota: $6.0M
- Current weighted coverage: 0.8x
- Identified shortfall: ~$1.2M

Top three deals that could be pulled forward if we expedite procurement:
1) Project Atlas — $600k, legal review in progress, procurement leverage with exec intro
2) FieldOps Platform — $300k, demo scheduled 5/5, awaiting budget sign-off
3) SupplyEdge — $200k, procurement requires vendor onboarding

We'll fill the commit sheet and upload the signed SOW draft where applicable. Note: procurement at Acme has a month-end freeze for new vendors effective May 15; if we want push into Q2 we need to close sooner.

Emma
Head of Digital Ops
Acme Hardware
---
Attachment: ACME_pipeline_snapshot.csv (text/csv)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acme-hardware.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline gap playbook & forecast lock for Q2 coverage

Thanks Emma — good detail. Internal readout and quick math below. (On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 11:05 AM Emma Chen wrote:)

> High level:
> - Weighted pipeline today: $4.8M
> - Quarterly quota: $6.0M
> - Current weighted coverage: 0.8x
> - Identified shortfall: ~$1.2M

Internal analysis (assumptions: conversion uplift if we prioritize exec intro and legal support):
- Baseline close from week-on-week velocity: $450k
- Upside from prioritized pull-forwards & exec assist: $700k
- Net achievable if we lock commit list by 5/6: $1.15M (covers ~96% of the gap)

Recommended sellers' playbook (high priority):
- Assign exec sponsor to Project Atlas (Marcus) and pursue procurement exception; schedule CEO-to-CEO intro this week.
- Run a 48-hour procurement fast-track with Acme Ops for FieldOps Platform (demo on 5/5).
- Offer a 60-day pilot SOW for SupplyEdge to reduce procurement friction; legal can scope a short pilot SOW.
- Put any low-probability deals (<30%) into "discovery" not commit; only include deals with Executive Buy-in or signed SOW in the commit sheet.

Action items: Marcus — can you confirm willingness to take Project Atlas exec intro and update probability in the commit sheet by EOD 5/4? Rachel — can you open the pilot SOW draft (SOW_draft_v3.pdf) and flag legal blockers?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acme-hardware.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline gap playbook & forecast lock for Q2 coverage

I can take Project Atlas — happy to do the CEO intro and push procurement. I'll update the commit sheet now. Summary:

- Project Atlas: moving to Commit (estimated close 5/12) — $600k
- FieldOps Platform: pushing for 5/5 demo -> PO by 5/11, probability to 65% -> $300k weighted
- SupplyEdge: propose pilot SOW to reduce procurement time, tentative $200k

I'll upload the signed bits and mark Project Atlas as "Commit" in ACME_Q2_commit_sheet.xlsx. For finance: please treat Project Atlas as a conditional commit pending exec intro and final PO; deal id RDW-2027-ACME-0423.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: SOW_draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@acme-hardware.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme-hardware.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline gap playbook & forecast lock for Q2 coverage

Appreciate the quick updates, team. Final checklist and next steps: 

1) Marcus: mark Project Atlas as Commit in the sheet (done) and confirm CEO intro scheduled (please DM time to coordinate).
2) Emma / Acme: upload any signed PO/SOW to the Drive link and confirm procurement path.
3) Rachel: please triage the SOW_draft_v3.pdf for legal blockers and post notes to the Drive folder.
4) Finance lock: Last call to submit Commit deals is 5pm PT on 2027-05-06. Anything not in the commit column after that will be treated as best-effort pipeline for forecast but excluded from the committed forecast.

I'll place a calendar hold for 5/6 4:00 PM PT for a final commit review (30 minutes). If we hit the ~$1.15M achievable number, I'll notify Finance to close the gap in the model and update our coverage ratio.

Links: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/companies/ACME-0423), Commit folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-Q2-commit)

Thanks — let's push this across the line.

Dylan Brooks
Sr. Director, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
